modeTitle.btw: Idle: start a turn. Running: send a BTW note to this session’s leader.
modeTitle.queue: Add a persistent prompt. If idle it starts immediately.
modeTitle.steer: Interrupt the current turn, then start your instruction. Clear pending queue first.

topic.body: A fresh context keeps earlier conversation details out of the next request. Project files and the recorded session stay available. This choice applies only when you approve sending.
